title: HTTP measurement sources
expiryHelp: From 1 to 365 days for creation and renewal. Changing the issuing account’s password or permissions, or closing all its sessions, invalidates its source credentials.
created: HTTP source created. Save the credential now.
rotated: Credential renewed. The previous credential is invalid.
rotateHelp: Renewing a token immediately invalidates the old one. Paused sources stay paused. Revoked sources need a new token to resume.
secretHelp: Save this token in your sender’s private settings now. It remains visible when refreshing this list, but disappears when hidden, when you leave or perform another action. Renew it if it is lost.
payload: Send a JSON object containing a decimal value as a string, the exact sensor unit (or null), and observed_at with an explicit timezone. Use the Authorization: Bearer header.
credentialInvalid: Credential expired, revoked or invalidated. Renew it before resuming.
empty: No HTTP sources yet. Hardware can still be used without an HTTP connection.
sourceHelp: A sensor already linked to Home Assistant cannot receive an HTTP source. Reads and reports keep their existing access rules.

errors.sourceHasMeasurements: This source has measurement history. Pause it to keep its history.
errors.invalidCredential: Invalid or unavailable HTTP source credential.
errors.sensorUnavailable: The sensor is missing, disabled, retired or no longer available to this source.
errors.alreadyLinked: This sensor already has an ingestion source. Use its existing source controls.
errors.conflict: This source changed. Reload before trying again.
errors.renewRequired: Renew this source credential before resuming.
errors.sampleConflict: A different reading already exists for this sensor and time.
errors.failed: The reading could not be stored. Retry later with the same timestamp and value.
errors.refreshFailed: Saved, but the source list could not be refreshed. Reload the list without repeating the action.

validation.expiryInvalid: Choose a lifetime of 1 to 365 whole days.
validation.valueInvalid: Send a decimal string with at most 12 integer and 9 fractional digits.
validation.unitInvalid: Send the exact sensor unit, or null for a unitless sensor.
validation.timeInvalid: Send a valid timestamp with timezone, from 2000 onward and at most five minutes in the future.
validation.payloadTooLarge: Send a JSON body of at most 4 KiB.
